name: Doenjang tofu stew
steps: Whisk the doenjang into a small pot of water to make a savoury broth.
Add the potato and onion and simmer until nearly tender.
Stir in the zucchini and mushrooms and cook a few more minutes.
Slide in the cubed firm tofu with the garlic and warm through.
Finish with green onion and serve piping hot.
